notes.title: Nigredo - Patch v0.1.4 Released
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613574/06c30e4e06c01ce9589b7480c4a9da0516566715.png"][/img]With Steam Next Fest over, we received a lot of valuable feedback![/p][p]We sincerely thank everyone who took the time to play the demo and especially those who went the extra mile to share their impressions with us.[/p][p]One recurring comment was the lack of a tutorial or help panel. In response, we’ve added a new in-game window that clearly explains the meaning of each icon and what they represent on the screen.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support. We humbly ask for even more feedback it’s essential for making Nigredo better and better![/p][p][/p][p]Also, follow us on [url="https://x.com/Pingado_Int"]twitter[/url]. We try to update daily what we're working on our projects.[/p][p][/p][p]— Team Pingado[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Nigredo - Patch v0.1.3 Released
notes.content:
Nigredo - Patch v0.1.3 Released



🔧 What's New:

Game Speed Setters: You can now directly set the game speed using number keys and the space key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613574/1bebf5f3830c5bf0786655b3248496ba1b0dce67.jpg[/img]

Keyboard Camera Controls: Navigate the environment with WASD.

Auto Save: Creates a save file called AutoSave every new day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613574/3eee8189d6e5efba02d5901b647e052d4426fbe1.jpg[/img]

These changes are part of our ongoing effort to tighten the game loop and improve accessibility. As always, your feedback helps shape Nigredo. More to come.

— Team Pingado
